_about: Eye and brow landmarks for add_mouth_rig.py, marked by hand on the standard flat face view (base colour only, orthographic, centre = Head bone + 0.20 x head height, width 0.70 x head height, looking at the face). Coordinates are fractions of that image: eyes [centre x, centre y, half width, half height] of the eye opening, brows [centre x, centre y]. Image left is the character's right.
